description: This Java class 'Proxifier' provides utility methods to create proxy instances of objects that implement interfaces, wrapping them with a specified 'Wrapper'. It leverages reflection to instantiate wrappers and Java's Proxy API to create dynamic proxies.

classes.name: Proxifier
classes.description: A utility class to generate proxy instances of objects, wrapping them with specified wrappers using reflection and dynamic proxies.

methods.name: proxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy instance of the object 't' using a wrapper class 'cls'. Instantiates the wrapper and passes it to a private method to generate the proxy.

methods.name: proxy
methods.description: Overloaded private method that creates a dynamic proxy for object 't' using the provided 'wrapper'.

methods.name: instantiate
methods.description: Uses reflection to instantiate a Wrapper object, passing the object 't' to its constructor.
